description: The summary of a CEP (Brazilian postal code): the center (latitude and longitude), the place, the counts, the Census and the source. For every address point, pass `detalhe: "pontos"`. We join CNEFE addresses, company records and census sectors. Use the prepared result instead of importing and joining those datasets. Addresses and census data reflect 2022. description: Write to the people behind the product: a question, or a sponsorship/partnership/advertising proposal. Free, no captcha and no payment; one message every 10 s per network (one that arrives sooner waits its turn). One route for a question and for a sponsorship, partnership or ad proposal (`tipo`, with the placements of `GET /api/partners`). No captcha, no account, no payment. One message every 10 seconds per network: one that arrives sooner waits its turn and then goes out — no error. The message reaches the team by e-mail, with `email` as the reply address. For voice, send multipart/form-data: `dados` is this JSON (up to 32 KiB), and `audio` is one WebM, Ogg or M4A audio file (up to 2 MB). Audio can replace message. The browser records up to two minutes. Audio is attached to the owner's e-mail.

annotations.title: Get API X402 CNPJ by CNPJ

description:
CNPJ lookup paid per call, without an account: the Federal Revenue record, the sanctions, the tax standing and the address on the map.
The same record as `GET /api/consulta/cnpj/:cnpj`, for agents: no account, no allowance and no pack. A request without payment gets the 402; a paid one gets the record in the same response, with the payment in `uso`. A lookup that fails or does not find the company is not charged.

cnia_atual.description: true requires a CNIA source check during this request. Source failure returns 503 without charging or using a previous record. Default false. Include sancoes when selecting topics.

cnpj.description: CNPJ with or without punctuation (14 characters).

temas.description: Comma-separated topics (up to 240 characters): dados, contagens, socios, sancoes, fiscal, divida, obras, trabalho, ibama, contratos, pep, vendas, campanhas, prefeituras, sicaf, aeronaves, fundos, rntrc, bndes, registros; todos. Omit for the full record. Basic company data always stays; partners require socios. contagens adds a contagens object with only the record counts: socios, pep, sancoes, fiscal, socioambiental, governo and registros. Unrequested fields are omitted; null means an unchecked source. SICAF, aircraft and RNTRC select registry agencies; registros includes all agencies. Prices, limits and personal data masking do not change.

description: The active, opened and closed companies within a radius in meters, by CNAE (activity code), with the recent openings and the distance. We import the address and company data and join them geographically. Query the neighborhood without downloading and indexing both datasets. CNEFE reflects 2022. Company positions and distances use postal codes. Check base, truncado and lenta. Missing counts are unknown, not zero. A result with lenta:true or missing counts does not consume the allowance or charge credit/x402. This does not measure foot traffic, demand or exact storefront positions.
